يبتليان (form VIII)
# يَبْتَلِيَانِ (yabtaliyāni) /jab.ta.li.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# يُبْتَلَيَانِ (yubtalayāni) /jub.ta.la.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
